source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Record the date, time, and precise location.
3. Identify the regulated substances being emitted.
4. Measure concentrations of regulated substances.
5. Use calibrated and approved measurement equipment.
6. Document meteorological data.
7. Include duration and frequency of emissions.
8. Account for any background concentrations.
9. Record visible signs of pollution (e.g., plumes, odors).
10. Take samples, following proper sampling protocols.
11. Compare findings against regulatory thresholds.
12. Document deviations from compliance and control measures.
13. Keep detailed logs of all observations and measurements.
14. Provide photographs, videos, or other visual evidence.
15. Account for any factors impacting emissions (e.g., equipment malfunction).
16. Review and verify all data collected.
17. Prepare a summary that includes key findings and any recommendations.
18. Report in the official format required by the regulatory agency.
19. Maintain confidentiality and privacy about sensitive information.
